content: For a Spring Boot + WebSocket SPA in 2025/2026, React (44.7% dev adoption per 2025 SO survey), Vue, and Svelte are all viable decoupled-frontend choices communicating via REST/WebSocket; choice should be driven by ecosystem maturity and team familiarity rather than a single best answer. React has the largest ecosystem of swipe/gesture/animation libraries and STOMP client examples paired with Spring Boot.
